=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:613-617 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `triage_release_download_rerun_gate`, the jq checks `(.total_count | type) == "number"` and `(.id | type) == "number" and .id > 0` accept non-integer values such as `1.5`, while the Python copy in scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py (`positive_number()` at :110-111, applied at :368, plus `type(count) is not int` at :363) accepts integers only.
  WHY: A payload that Python rejects as `jobs_unreadable` passes the shell gate and is cached in `RELEASE_DOWNLOAD_RERUN_JOBS_FILE` (scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:630-633), which breaks the documented "keep the bounds and checks of both copies in sync" rule. GitHub returns integer ids, so the practical impact is near zero. All four reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low) and agree on severity.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:924-957 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `triage_run_failed_job_names` reads the shared payload file (`RELEASE_DOWNLOAD_RERUN_JOBS_FILE`) with `cat` and has no guard against a partly written file.
  WHY: If the gate is still writing the file when it is read, jq gets truncated JSON, the function fails and falls back to a redundant fresh API call. The reviewer rated this NIT (mapped to low). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked the same pass-1 concern and dropped it: the write at :630 finishes earlier in the same sequential invocation, nothing else writes the file, and the reader re-validates and fails open.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

The comments at scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py lines 327, 343 and 376 say "keep the bounds and checks of both copies in sync", so the integer-vs-number difference contradicts the "no remaining drift" clause.   PROBLEM: The jq checks accept non-integer numbers such as `1.5`, while `positive_number()` in ci_cancelled_rerun.py:110-111 and `type(count) is not int` (line 363) accept integers only. The comments at ci_cancelled_rerun.py:344-345 and check_failure_triage.sh:608-610 say the two copies must stay in sync.

- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: scripts/check_failure_triage.sh, triage_release_download_rerun_gate jq filter, lines 613-616. Append `and (.total_count | floor) == .total_count` and `and (.id | floor) == .id`. Estimated lines changed: 2. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
